sqlMap.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.BUYER, A.INV_NO, A.INV_TYPE AS PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMIVHD A INNER JOIN ICOMIVDT B ON (1 = 1 AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.INV_NO = A.INV_NO ) INNER JOIN ICOMPODT C ON (1 = 1 AND C.BUYER = B.BUYER AND C.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND C.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ AND TRIM(C.LEGACY_PO_NO) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(C.LEGACY_PO_NO) NOT LIKE 'P%' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE 1 = 1 AND DOC_NAME = 'SAP_X_IV' AND TARGET = C.BUYER AND KEY_1 = C.PO_NO AND KEY_2 = C.PO_SEQ ) ) WHERE A.BUYER IN (SELECT DISTINCT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C002' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKOLOG001' AND FLAG = 'Y') AND A.BUYER != 'KRKOLO0105' AND A.INV_TYPE = '0' AND A.SND_CHK = 'N'
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT A.BUYER, A.INV_NO, '2' AS PROCESS_TYPE FROM WMSIVDT A INNER JOIN ICOMPODT C ON (1 = 1 AND C.BUYER = A.BUYER AND C.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND C.PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND TRIM(C.LEGACY_PO_NO) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(C.LEGACY_PO_NO) NOT LIKE 'P%' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE 1 = 1 AND DOC_NAME = 'SAP_X_IV' AND TARGET = C.BUYER AND KEY_1 = C.PO_NO AND KEY_2 = C.PO_SEQ ) ) WHERE A.BUYER IN (SELECT DISTINCT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C002' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKOLOG001' AND FLAG = 'Y') AND A.BUYER != 'KRKOLO0105' AND A.SND_CHK = 'N' ) ORDER BY Z.BUYER, Z.INV_NO

SELECT A.INV_NO AS LIFEX, A.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL AS VBELN, '10000191' AS LIFNR, A.INV_DATE AS LFDAT, CASE WHEN A.STATUS != 'D' THEN 'C' WHEN A.STATUS = 'D' THEN 'D' END AS TYPE FROM ICOMIVHD A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND A.INV_TYPE = '0' AND A.SND_CHK = 'N' ORDER BY A.INV_NO

SELECT A.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL AS VBELN, B.INV_NO AS LIFEX, TO_NUMBER(B.INV_SEQ) * 10 AS POSNR, E.EBELN AS EBELN, E.EBELP AS EBELP, E.MATNR AS MATNR, B.INV_QTY AS MENGE, E.MEINS AS MEINS, '' AS LICHN, 'KR' AS SPE_HERKL, '' AS HSDAT, REPLACE(D.IRS_NO,'-','') AS STCD2, D.COM_NAME_LOC AS NAME1, '' AS TEXT1, '' AS TEXT2 FROM ICOMIVHD A INNER JOIN ICOMIVDT B ON (1 = 1 AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.INV_NO = A.INV_NO ) INNER JOIN ICOMPODT C ON (1 = 1 AND C.BUYER = B.BUYER AND C.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND C.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ ) INNER JOIN ICOMCMPY D ON (1 = 1 AND D.COM_CODE = A.AGENT ) INNER JOIN IF_KOLON_EKPO E ON (1 = 1 AND TRIM(E.EBELN) = C.LEGACY_PO_NO AND E.EBELP = C.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND E.KEP_SEQ = (SELECT MAX(KEP_SEQ) FROM IF_KOLON_EKPO WHERE TRIM(EBELN) = TRIM(E.EBELN) AND EBELP = E.EBELP) ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND A.INV_TYPE = '0' AND A.SND_CHK = 'N' ORDER BY B.INV_NO, B.INV_SEQ

SELECT DISTINCT A.INV_NO AS LIFEX, A.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL AS VBELN, '10000191' AS LIFNR, A.INV_DATE AS LFDAT, CASE WHEN A.STATUS != 'D' THEN 'C' WHEN A.STATUS = 'D' THEN 'D' END AS TYPE FROM WMSIVDT A WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND A.SND_CHK = 'N' ORDER BY A.INV_NO

SELECT A.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL AS VBELN, A.INV_NO AS LIFEX, TO_NUMBER(A.INV_SEQ) * 10 AS POSNR, E.EBELN AS EBELN, E.EBELP AS EBELP, E.MATNR AS MATNR, A.INV_QTY AS MENGE, E.MEINS AS MEINS, '' AS LICHN, 'KR' AS SPE_HERKL, '' AS HSDAT, REPLACE(D.IRS_NO,'-','') AS STCD2, D.COM_NAME_LOC AS NAME1, '' AS TEXT1, '' AS TEXT2 FROM WMSIVDT A INNER JOIN ICOMPODT B ON (1 = 1 AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND B.PROCESS_TYPE = A.PROCESS_TYPE ) INNER JOIN ICOMCMPY D ON (1 = 1 AND D.COM_CODE = A.AGENT ) INNER JOIN IF_KOLON_EKPO E ON (1 = 1 AND TRIM(E.EBELN) = B.LEGACY_PO_NO AND E.EBELP = B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND E.KEP_SEQ = (SELECT MAX(KEP_SEQ) FROM IF_KOLON_EKPO WHERE TRIM(EBELN) = TRIM(E.EBELN) AND EBELP = E.EBELP) ) WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND A.SND_CHK = 'N' ORDER BY A.INV_NO, A.INV_SEQ
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ICOMIVHD SET LEGACY_IV_SERIAL = #LEGACY_IV_SERIAL#, SND_CHK = 'Y', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND INV_NO = #INV_NO#
UPDATE WMSIVDT SET LEGACY_IV_SERIAL = #LEGACY_IV_SERIAL#, SND_CHK = 'Y', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND INV_NO = #INV_NO#

UPDATE EAI.IF_KOLON_LIKP SET IF_FLAG = 'T' , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND IF_FLAG = 'N' AND BUYER = NVL(TRIM(#BUYER#), BUYER) AND BUYER != 'KRKOLO0105' AND INV_NO LIKE CASE WHEN '0' = #PROCESS_TYPE# THEN 'IV' WHEN '2' = #PROCESS_TYPE# THEN 'IK' END || '%'
UPDATE EAI.IF_KOLON_LIKP SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATM = SYSDATE , VBELN = #LEGACY_IV_SERIAL# WHERE 1 = 1 AND IF_FLAG = 'T' AND BUYER = #BUYER# AND INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND TYPE = #TYPE#
UPDATE EAI.IF_KOLON_LIKP SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATM = SYSDATE , IF_MSG = SUBSTRB(#IF_MSG#,1,4000) WHERE 1 = 1 AND IF_FLAG = 'T' AND BUYER = #BUYER# AND INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND TYPE = #TYPE#
UPDATE EAI.IF_KOLON_LIPS SET VBELN = #LEGACY_IV_SERIAL# WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = #BUYER# AND INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND TYPE = #TYPE#
sqlMap.select: SELECT A.BUYER, A.INV_NO, A.TYPE, A.VBELN, CASE WHEN A.INV_NO LIKE 'IV%' THEN (SELECT ADD_DATE||ADD_TIME FROM ICOMIVHD WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND INV_NO = A.INV_NO) WHEN A.INV_NO LIKE 'IK%' THEN (SELECT MAX(ADD_DATE||ADD_TIME) FROM WMSIVDT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND INV_NO = A.INV_NO) END AS PROCESS_TIME FROM EAI.IF_KOLON_LIKP A WHERE IF_FLAG = 'T' AND BUYER != 'KRKOLO0105' AND BUYER = NVL(TRIM(#BUYER#), BUYER) AND INV_NO LIKE CASE WHEN '0' = #PROCESS_TYPE# THEN 'IV' WHEN '2' = #PROCESS_TYPE# THEN 'IK' END || '%' ORDER BY PROCESS_TIME, TYPE
SELECT LIFEX, VBELN, LIFNR, LFDAT, TYPE FROM EAI.IF_KOLON_LIKP WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = #BUYER# AND INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND TYPE = #TYPE# AND IF_FLAG = 'T'

SELECT VBELN, LIFEX, POSNR, EBELN, EBELP, MATNR, MENGE, MEINS, LICHN, SPE_HERKL, HSDAT, STCD2, NAME1, TEXT1, TEXT2 FROM EAI.IF_KOLON_LIPS WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = #BUYER# AND INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND TYPE = #TYPE#
